ttea.games.kartea.gamemodel

Game models of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

This package provides the objects drawn and moved during a match: the pseudo-3D road, the car, targets and obstacles, plus image and sound loading helpers. Developed by the Larva UDESC team.

Attributes

__version__str

The current version of the package.

__date__str

The release date of this version.

__author__str

The development team.

__license__str

The license under which the package is distributed.

See Also

Background

Renders the horizon, the pseudo-3D road and its sprites.

Line

One segment of the pseudo-3D road.

Car

Car controlled by the player’s feet.

Target, Obstacle, KillResult

Objects on the road and the result of removing one.

Image, Sound

Loading of images and sounds from files or Qt resources.

Notes

This package is maintained by the Larva UDESC team and is under active development. Contributions and bug reports are welcome at: https://github.com/larvattea/ttea

Modules

background

Rendering of the KarTEA horizon, pseudo-3D road and sprites.

car

Car controlled by the player in the KarTEA game.

image

Loading, scaling and drawing of game images (pygame).

line

Segment (line) of the KarTEA pseudo-3D road.

obstacle

Obstacle object of the KarTEA road.

sound

Loading of game sounds (pygame) from the QRC or from files.

target

Target (star) object of the KarTEA road and its kill result.
